entries.reason: Checked the official uit.edu.vn homepage and its dedicated 'gioi-thieu-chung' (general introduction/about) page directly. All homepage/carousel banners found (uit_bannerweb_gioithieu_02.jpg, uit_bannerweb_20nam.png, uit_bannerweb_tuyensinh.png, banner_kiem_dinh.png) are stylized marketing graphics with overlaid slogan text and/or the same '20 năm' (20-year anniversary, 2006-2026) badge already flagged in the first pass - none is genuine unstaged campus photography. The about page's own inline images are only small decorative icons (max 223x226px), not cover-quality. No press/media/brand-kit page link was found on the site. Remains held; did not substitute a marketing graphic or a low-resolution icon.

No new identity information was found in this pass. This remains an unresolved-identity record, not a source-availability problem; no logo or cover is nominated.
